themes.name: Affordable and Efficient Housing
themes.rule: Includes proposals to create, preserve, make more affordable, improve the energy performance of, or increase transparency in residential housing.

themes.name: Education and Student Support
themes.rule: Includes proposals concerning schools, teachers, pupils, educational facilities, tutoring, school meals, or free learning and arts instruction for children.

themes.name: Health and Care Services
themes.rule: Includes proposals to improve access to medical care, preventive screening, mental-health services, emergency health response, or in-home support for older residents.

themes.name: Public Transport and Street Mobility
themes.rule: Includes proposals to improve bus access, fares, frequency, rider information, cycling infrastructure, or road safety for people traveling through the city.

themes.name: Digital and Municipal Access
themes.rule: Includes proposals to make city information, public internet, municipal procedures, service requests, or assistance using city services more accessible.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability and Green Space
themes.rule: Includes proposals addressing clean energy, waste reduction, recycling, pollution monitoring, urban trees, parks, gardens, or other environmental improvements.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Includes proposals to support residents' employment and retraining or to reduce barriers and provide finance, workspace, or local-hiring opportunities for businesses and workers.

themes.name: Culture, Recreation and Community Amenities
themes.rule: Includes proposals for cultural programming, arts access, libraries, playgrounds, dog areas, or other shared recreational and neighborhood gathering amenities.

themes.name: Public Safety and Emergency Protection
themes.rule: Includes proposals to prevent crime, improve street safety through lighting or policing, deploy security cameras, or expand fire and ambulance coverage.
